web-guide-idea-53.audience: Singers or instrumental learners needing individual practice feedback.
web-guide-idea-53.offer: Offer focused coaching within your own teaching experience. Choose a small passage or technique and make the session about deliberate practice.
web-guide-idea-53.steps.0: Ask for the learner’s level and chosen piece.
web-guide-idea-53.steps.1: Listen, isolate one difficulty and demonstrate slowly.
web-guide-idea-53.steps.2: Have the learner repeat it and agree a manageable practice routine.
web-guide-idea-53.equipment: A phone, clear sound and the learner’s instrument if relevant. A quiet room matters more than expensive video equipment.
web-guide-idea-53.returnReason: Track the same skill across new exercises so returning learners can recognise progress.
web-guide-idea-53.promotion: Share a short teaching demonstration and accurately describe your musical background.
